name: DEXTROMETHORPHAN / PARACETAMOL / CHLORPHENAMINE / PHENYLEPHHRINE 12 CAPSULES SIMI 1-2-3
description: Flu-fighting remedy that, thanks to its formula, relieves flu symptoms (fever, body aches, nasal congestion, runny nose) as well as the annoying symptoms of a cough, helping to quickly treat it. If discomfort persists, consult your doctor.
